---
title: "Brain Data"
author: "Kitt Smith"
---

Total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain of humans, pigs and mice, using data from the Human Protein Atlas (HPA).

```{r}
sum(180, 83, 57, 110)
```
Total genes with regionally elevated expression in humans is 430.

```{r}
sum(109, 157, 31, 45)
```
Total genes with regionally elevated expression in pigs is 342.

```{r}
sum(55, 185, 60, 98)
```
Total genes with regionally elevated expression in mice is 398.

Humans have the greatest total number of genes in the forebrain with regionally elevated expression.
